title: Introducing Spyglass: Your New Standard for Insight
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, providing you with powerful, intuitive insights to enhance your daily workflow.

title: Enhanced File Management & Visual Control in Your Editor
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your documents and images with new capabilities to upload, manage, and tailor their visual display directly within the editor.

title: Discover Our Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap page for a transparent look at recently shipped features, upcoming updates, and exciting future plans.

title: Seamless Checkbox Interaction
summary: Enjoy a smoother, more modern editing experience with our newly enhanced, draggable, and easier-to-use checkboxes.

title: Smarter Collaboration Tools
summary: We've upgraded our collaboration tools to make working with your team smoother and more intuitive than ever before.

title: Enhanced Shared Content Discovery
summary: Easily find and access all items shared with you, empowering more fluid collaboration and ensuring you never miss valuable content.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Noeko is expanding its language capabilities to welcome users from every corner of the globe, ensuring a truly inclusive experience.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to open-source Noeko's codebase, empowering our community with maximum control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's exciting future.

title: Discover Deeper Connections in Your Knowledge Base
summary: Transform your graph view into a powerful exploration hub with advanced filtering by tags and time, plus the ability to effortlessly view shared content and collaborators, making your knowledge discovery more intuitive and insightful.

title: Precision Search and Curated Collections
summary: Elevate your search experience with powerful filtering by tags and time, enabling you to save personalized collections of your knowledge for quick and efficient retrieval.

title: Flexible Content Display
summary: Experience a more intuitive and interactive way to organize your notes with flexible display options and dynamic content previews that bring your linked ideas to life.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting and Advanced Plans for Ultimate Control
summary: We're excited to offer Noeko's self-hosting capabilities and introduce new premium plans, providing enhanced control and features tailored to your unique requirements.

title: Transform Your Look with Vibrant New Themes and Refreshed Classics
summary: We're introducing a vibrant collection of new themes and meticulously polishing existing ones to give you more ways to personalize your application's appearance and elevate your experience.

title: Dynamic Time-Aware Welcome
summary: Experience a more precise and personalized welcome as we refine our greetings to perfectly align with the current time of day.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new direct actions, allowing you to quickly remove items from tags and perform other essential tasks right from your tag view.

title: Expand Your Content Sources
summary: We are introducing support for a wider range of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you to gather all your valuable information seamlessly within the platform.
